bounded_objective: Use the independently reviewed quadratic theorem as a transfer mechanism: prove the exact GU'(a,b) law under disjoint multiplication by an arbitrary-dimensional quadratic phase, then instantiate it as a larger restriction-closed bounded-seed class with all parameter dependence explicit.
method: Factor Fourier masses and upper caps on disjoint blocks; derive exact additivity of U,H,I,G; combine with reviewed G(q)<=3I(q); bound arbitrary k-bit seeds using entropy support, nonnegative child U, and cube edge connectivity.
prior_status: Quadratic phases satisfied G<=3I, U<=I and H<=2I; no exact arbitrary-seed GU' transfer or larger bounded-core class was recorded.
mathematical_delta: A seed GU'(a,b) inequality transfers to disjoint quadratic products as GU'(max(3,a),b), preserving b exactly and independently of quadratic dimension/rank/overlap. For arbitrary Boolean seeds of width k this yields G<=max(3,k*2^(k-1))I, U<=2^(k-1)I and H<=max(2,2^(k-1))I.

case_extension.starting_class: All quadratic phases, arbitrary dimension and rank.
case_extension.new_class: Arbitrary quadratic phases times arbitrary Boolean terminal cores on at most k disjoint variables.
case_extension.quantifiers: Every k>=1; every quadratic block dimension, rank and graph; every Boolean seed on at most k variables.
case_extension.previous_bound: G<=3I, U<=I, H<=2I on quadratic phases.
case_extension.new_bound: G<=max(3,k*2^(k-1))I, U<=2^(k-1)I, H<=max(2,2^(k-1))I on the product class.
case_extension.parameter_dependence: Independent of every quadratic parameter; grows with seed width k.
case_extension.universal_gap: No dimension-independent GU' payment inside arbitrary-width seeds is proved.
